dse_runs.notes: Wideband DDS: need >=400 MSPS single-lane sin/cos with max_abs_err <= 2^-12, minimize LUTs. Explore pipelined/pipelined_m families for throughput; iterative/unrolled_k may not reach 400 MSPS single-lane. Prioritize feasible region on throughput and error.

final_text: The single spec in the queue, `infeasible_dds_400msps`, was taken down the full ladder and finalized as infeasible. I spent the entire 400-evaluation L1 budget: the structured `run_dse` graph consumed 200 evals (its inner architect declared the spec infeasible and added a family rather than finding a feasible point), then I spent the remaining 200 on two targeted NSGA-II studies — `pipelined` (100 evals, 0 feasible) and `pipelined_m` (100 evals, 0 feasible). No design anywhere in the explored space simultaneously satisfied `throughput_msps >= 400` and `max_abs_err <= 2^-12` on a single lane, so there was no front to shortlist. Consequently L2 `simulate_system` reported "nothing feasible to simulate," L3 `verify_rtl` and L4 `synthesize` had no selected design, and L5 `back_annotate` was skipped (no winner change, so no `reexplore`). I finalized the spec with no selection, recording that all 400 L1 evaluations were spent and zero feasible designs were found — the spec is genuinely infeasible under its constraints, not merely under-explored.
